messages.subject: checking initial values + gradients
parts:
Daniel suggested that Stan inspect the initial
values and return an error message to the user if

1. any initial param value is not finite (i.e.,
any of them is NaN or Inf or -Inf) or

2. any of the initial gradients is not finite.

There's no way to recover from either of those states,
is there?

- Bob

messages.author: 1004dd6f66bb10c3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] checking initial values + gradients
